inputs.name: Height
inputs.meaning: Standing body height; not skill or automatic defensive impact.

inputs.name: Wingspan
inputs.meaning: Arm-span measurement supporting reach geometry.

inputs.name: Standing reach
inputs.meaning: Measured overhead reach. If unavailable, estimate with uncertainty; do not add height and wingspan again as extra contest bonuses.

inputs.name: Body mass
inputs.meaning: Mass relevant to contact and inertia; not equivalent to functional strength.

inputs.name: Acceleration / first step
inputs.meaning: Rate of gaining movement speed, without the ball.

inputs.name: Straight-line speed
inputs.meaning: Attainable movement speed over distance.

inputs.name: Lateral mobility / change of direction
inputs.meaning: Without-ball lateral movement, braking and redirection capacity. Do not infer this directly from screen-navigation success. Separate lateral/COD observations may be retained beneath this family.

inputs.name: Functional strength
inputs.meaning: Capacity to apply/resist force. Contact leverage technique remains a separate skill.

inputs.name: Physical balance / stability
inputs.meaning: Capacity to maintain or regain bodily control. Learned footwork and decision quality are separate.

inputs.name: Vertical / jump capacity
inputs.meaning: Reach added by jumping. Standing reach + jump determines potential coverage; timing determines how effectively it is used.

inputs.name: Conditioning
inputs.meaning: Ability to sustain repeated workload before execution deteriorates.

inputs.name: Recovery between efforts
inputs.meaning: Rate of recovering from exertion during rest/lower-intensity periods. Not injury recovery or developmental resilience.

inputs.name: Catch-and-shoot three-point execution
inputs.meaning: Shot preparation and accuracy from a catch at reference three-point distance. Not assumed equal to pull-up ability.

inputs.name: Pull-up three-point execution
inputs.meaning: Dribble pickup, shot footwork and accuracy from a live dribble at reference distance.

inputs.name: Movement three-point execution
inputs.meaning: Shooting while settling from substantial off-ball movement. Movement and catch labels can overlap; use a conditional model, not both full bonuses.

inputs.name: Catch-and-shoot midrange execution
inputs.meaning: Midrange catch preparation and accuracy.

inputs.name: Pull-up midrange execution
inputs.meaning: Midrange live-dribble shot execution.

inputs.name: Movement midrange execution
inputs.meaning: Midrange execution after off-ball movement; sparse evidence should remain visibly uncertain.

inputs.name: Free-throw execution
inputs.meaning: Uncontested free-throw shooting skill. Release speed is not an input to this talent.

inputs.name: Release / preparation technique
inputs.meaning: How quickly the player can prepare and release an appropriate shot without losing their usual mechanics. Actual release window also depends on the shot type and contest.

inputs.name: Distance-extension technique
inputs.meaning: Ability to preserve mechanics as distance increases beyond a reference shot. Derived usable range also requires sufficient accuracy and willingness; this is not a second universal accuracy bonus.

inputs.name: Layup / close-touch execution
inputs.meaning: Control, angle, touch and hand use on close attempts. Does not establish ability to get to the rim.

inputs.name: Floater / short-paint touch
inputs.meaning: Converting floaters and short-paint touch shots; distinct from explosive paint access.

inputs.name: Dunk execution
inputs.meaning: Takeoff coordination and ball control when a dunk is physically available. Reach/vertical determine availability, not this skill alone.

inputs.name: Aerial catch-to-finish execution
inputs.meaning: Timing and coordination to receive and finish airborne chances. Combines with receiving and the appropriate finish, without treating every assisted basket as a lob.

inputs.name: Receiving / catch control
inputs.meaning: Securing and preparing to use an incoming pass, including difficult deliveries.

inputs.name: Contact finishing technique
inputs.meaning: Protecting the ball, adjusting and preserving finish control through contact. Strength contributes separately to effective contact tolerance.

inputs.name: Dribble manipulation
inputs.meaning: Ball control through changes of hand, direction, speed and dribble moves. Does not itself confer physical speed.

inputs.name: Handle security
inputs.meaning: Protecting possession against pressure. Must directly influence ball-loss risk at comparable exposure.

inputs.name: Perimeter separation craft
inputs.meaning: Footwork, fakes, counters and deception that create shot or attack space. Complements dribble manipulation, rather than measuring the same moves twice.

inputs.name: Driving craft
inputs.meaning: Choosing/maintaining attack angles, using the defender's hip, changing pace and exploiting lanes.

inputs.name: Attack recognition
inputs.meaning: Recognizing when to shoot, drive, post, reset or move the advantage. Specific passing reads live in F01-F09.

inputs.name: Post establishment / sealing
inputs.meaning: Technique to gain and retain useful receiving/post position.

inputs.name: Post moves / counters
inputs.meaning: Footwork, fakes and counters to create a post advantage.

inputs.name: Post-specific finish execution
inputs.meaning: Hooks and other post-specific release techniques. A generic layup or jumper from the post still uses its own shot skill, not two full accuracy ratings.

inputs.name: Foul-drawing craft
inputs.meaning: Timing and body/ball placement that draw legal contact during an available attack. Does not create free throws without an attack and defender interaction.

inputs.name: Cutting-route execution
inputs.meaning: Timing, deception, route choice and presenting a usable receiving window. Speed is supplied by physical tools; frequency by tendencies/assignments.

inputs.name: Relocation / shooting-route execution
inputs.meaning: Timing and disguising relocation, using screens and arriving prepared to shoot. The subsequent shot uses S01-S06 as appropriate.

inputs.name: Screen execution
inputs.meaning: Screen angle, placement, legal positioning and contact technique. Body size/strength do not automatically establish competence.

inputs.name: Screen-action recognition
inputs.meaning: Recognizing when to hold, re-screen, slip, roll or pop. Passing after the catch uses the relevant passing family.

inputs.name: Offensive rebound reading / pursuit technique
inputs.meaning: Reading shot trajectory, finding a route and establishing offensive rebounding position. Not simply observed offensive rebounds.

inputs.name: Defensive rebound reading / positioning
inputs.meaning: Reading misses and securing advantageous defensive rebounding position.

inputs.name: Box-out technique
inputs.meaning: Finding an opponent, gaining legal leverage and maintaining a seal. Can create a teammate's rebound.

inputs.name: Rebound control
inputs.meaning: Timing and controlling/tipping a reachable ball. Reach, jump and strength are supplied separately.

inputs.name: On-ball containment technique
inputs.meaning: Stance, angles, footwork and spacing to keep an assignment contained. Effective containment also needs movement tools.

inputs.name: Contact resistance / leverage technique
inputs.meaning: Absorbing, redirecting and resisting contact through technique; physical strength and balance remain distinct.

inputs.name: Screen-navigation technique
inputs.meaning: Approach, body positioning and route technique around screens. Not another copy of lateral speed.

inputs.name: Interior positioning
inputs.meaning: Establishing depth/angle relative to the rim, ball, attacker and roller. Specifically interior, not every kind of defensive positioning.

inputs.name: Contest technique
inputs.meaning: Timing, hand/body placement and controlled vertical execution to challenge a shot. Shot context selects the relevant response; blocks are possible outcomes, not a second skill bonus.

inputs.name: Rotation recognition
inputs.meaning: Identifying help responsibilities, tags, switches and the next threat early enough to act.

inputs.name: Off-ball coverage positioning
inputs.meaning: Executing useful gap, denial, tag and recovery starting positions away from the primary matchup. Distinct from interior positioning, with legitimate overlap in evidence.

inputs.name: Closeout / arrival control
inputs.meaning: Approaching under control, managing angle/distance and avoiding an easy blow-by or foul. Physical travel speed is separate.

inputs.name: Defensive anticipation
inputs.meaning: Reading handler cues, passing windows and movement routes. It informs several tasks, but does not duplicate their execution skills.

inputs.name: On-ball steal technique
inputs.meaning: Timing and placement of hands to dislodge or take the ball.

inputs.name: Passing-lane interception technique
inputs.meaning: Executing interceptions and deflections of reachable passes. Recognition and reach also matter.

inputs.name: Attention / responsibility execution
inputs.meaning: Maintaining awareness of ball, assignment and coverage responsibilities. Not identical to intelligence or voluntary effort.

inputs.name: Foul-control technique
inputs.meaning: Maintaining legal contact/contest execution in difficult actions. Intentional tactical fouls are a separate decision.

inputs.name: Defensive communication
inputs.meaning: Recognizing and delivering useful coverage calls. Proposed team-coordination skill, not a personality/leadership rating or a universal defense bonus. Evidence may be scouting-led.

inputs.name: Connector / swing / reversal — recognition
inputs.meaning: Identify the next useful continuation or ball reversal

inputs.name: Connector / swing / reversal — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver the continuation accurately and on time

inputs.name: Post entry — recognition
inputs.meaning: Read the seal, denial and entry window

inputs.name: Post entry — execution
inputs.meaning: Place the entry where the receiver can secure/use it

inputs.name: Pocket / roll feed — recognition
inputs.meaning: Read roller availability, coverage and the gap

inputs.name: Pocket / roll feed — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver through the gap at the receiver's useful height/pace

inputs.name: Lob — recognition
inputs.meaning: Identify aerial availability and help timing

inputs.name: Lob — execution
inputs.meaning: Place trajectory/timing for a usable aerial finish

inputs.name: Short-roll playmaking — recognition
inputs.meaning: Read the advantage after the screener catches in space

inputs.name: Short-roll playmaking — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver the appropriate pass from that short-roll situation

inputs.name: Drive-and-kick — recognition
inputs.meaning: Read help commitment and the perimeter outlet

inputs.name: Drive-and-kick — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver accurately while driving or exiting the drive

inputs.name: Skip / cross-court — recognition
inputs.meaning: Identify a useful weak-side window beyond nearer receivers

inputs.name: Skip / cross-court — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver across the defense with appropriate pace/trajectory

inputs.name: Post playmaking — recognition
inputs.meaning: Read cutters, doubles and outlets from the post

inputs.name: Post playmaking — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver out of post position, including constrained body angles

inputs.name: Transition / outlet / advance — recognition
inputs.meaning: Recognize an available advantage upcourt

inputs.name: Transition / outlet / advance — execution
inputs.meaning: Deliver an accurate moving/long advance or outlet

inputs.name: Shoot / drive / pass / post / reset choices
inputs.meaning: Conditional action distribution given the available options.

inputs.name: Shot-location preferences
inputs.meaning: Spatial attempt preferences, including side/region tendencies. Not regional accuracy.

inputs.name: Shooting-mode preferences
inputs.meaning: Catch, pull-up and movement attempt preferences conditional on opportunity.

inputs.name: Shot difficulty tolerance
inputs.meaning: Willingness to attempt contested, early or difficult shots; game state modifies the decision.

inputs.name: Pace / early-attack preference
inputs.meaning: Preference to advance or attack before the defense is set.

inputs.name: Dribble / possession persistence
inputs.meaning: Preference to retain the ball and continue probing rather than move it.

inputs.name: Passing risk appetite
inputs.meaning: Willingness to attempt difficult/high-reward deliveries. Not pass recognition or accuracy.

inputs.name: Offensive involvement preference
inputs.meaning: Tendency to seek touches/initiations. Actual usage is limited by coach plans, teammates and opportunity.

inputs.name: Cutting frequency
inputs.meaning: How often the player seeks a cut when opportunities arise.

inputs.name: Relocation / off-ball movement frequency
inputs.meaning: How often the player seeks another receiving/shooting location.

inputs.name: Screen / roll / pop / slip preferences
inputs.meaning: Conditional mix of screen actions and follow-ups.

inputs.name: Offensive crash versus retreat
inputs.meaning: Preference to pursue a miss versus recover defensively. Skill and coach strategy determine whether this is useful.

inputs.name: Defensive pursuit versus box-out emphasis
inputs.meaning: How the player allocates attention between collecting and securing space for others. Not a choice to abandon all rebounding.

inputs.name: Steal / disruption gamble frequency
inputs.meaning: Attempt appetite at a given apparent opening. Separate from execution and anticipation.

inputs.name: Help commitment
inputs.meaning: Willingness to leave an assignment, stunt or commit to help within the scheme.

inputs.name: Contest commitment / stay-down preference
inputs.meaning: Choice to jump, contest conservatively or preserve position. Technique governs the consequences.

inputs.name: Effort allocation
inputs.meaning: Offensive, defensive and transition workload choices. Conditioning limits sustainability; high offensive usage is not automatic proof of defensive laziness.

inputs.name: Contact-seeking preference
inputs.meaning: Whether the player seeks contact or avoids it while attacking. Foul-drawing and contact finishing are separate skills.
